name: frontend-studio
description: Two researchers in parallel, then a reviewer handoff chain.

nodes.prompt: Collect three reference layouts for the requested page. Output bullet facts only.
Collect three copy drafts for the requested page. Output bullet facts only.
Merge the researchers facts into one build plan with file list.
Review the build plan for missing files and contradictions. Output PASS or blocking issues.

edges.instruction: When researcher_a finishes, hand its fact bullets to director so the plan covers every layout fact.
When researcher_b finishes, hand its copy bullets to director so the plan covers every copy fact.
When the build plan is ready, hand the full plan to reviewer and expect PASS or a blocking-issue list.
